name: Shota Yuusha no Junan 5 ~Choi Defo-shiki Adventure Game~
original_name: ショタ勇者の受難5 ～ちょいデフォ式アドベンチャーゲーム～
source:
The shota hero was too dependent on a (lousy) goddess! 
Any little problem and he's a weakling who'll die. 
He needs to evade the stones and monsters and get to the village. 

Help him navigate here and there, dodging trouble. 
If he gets smacked, it's game over. 
Watch out for getting eaten by monsters. 

A simple choice & evasion game :) 

Good luck. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171439.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
少年英雄过度依赖（糟糕的）女神！只要遇到一点小问题，他就会变成一碰就死的弱者。
他必须躲开石头和怪物，抵达村庄。

帮助他四处前进，躲避危险。如果他被重击，游戏就结束了。小心别被怪物吃掉。

这是一款简单的选择与躲避游戏:)

祝你好运。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE171439.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
